replication.target_description: Study 1, replication of Nuttin (1987): liking probabilities for letters in first names versus letters not in first names, computed per alphabet letter; letter-level t(25) comparison accompanying the reported d = 1.08. Ranking outcome is separate.

n.sample_role: Alphabet letters: 26 paired letter-level liking proportions, each computed across contributing participants; not 26 participants.
n.exclusions: No letter excluded from Table 3 liking proportions (A–Z, including X). First-name provision was optional and participants were asked whether their name was real; the exact contributing participant count is not asserted here. Supplementary p. 5 states no data exclusions generally.
n.location: Manuscript pp. 9–11, Study 1 Method/Measures/Liking results; p. 41, Table 3 (A–Z). Supplementary p. 5, Data exclusions.
n.quote:
The 26 English letters were then presented in alphabetical order. ... For each letter, we calculated its average likelihood of being selected
